summary: The agent provides a highly sophisticated solution with excellent domain-specific feature engineering, a custom neural network using spatial symmetries, and strong gradient boosting models. However, it suffers from evaluation bias: it optimizes its ensemble blending weights on the validation set and reports the score on the same data, leading to an over-optimistic final validation accuracy. It also relies on a single split evaluation and reports only accuracy.
